title: Continued Growth + Architecting

quotations.quote: elective courses that are co-developed by the participating universities
developing these courses and test them out.

description: 6 answers combine Continued Growth as their dominant future orientation with Architecting as their primary action position.
interpretation: These answers couple expanded existing exchange with concrete course, project or infrastructure design. They show that Architecting can reproduce and improve the existing system.

exceptions.rationale: Dator secondary: Discipline. Proposes partner universities co-developing and hosting courses: a concrete design at partnership scale, still aspirational.

Dator secondary: Discipline. AREAS secondary: Shaped. Reports embedding small elements on their own initiative, while sustained collaboration depends on university resources. Local design coexists with being shaped by funding.
AREAS secondary: Shaped. Reports institutional incentives and a completed EDDA camp, but says barriers remain. Institutions can organise local opportunities without removing students’ constraints.

caveat: Recurring means at least two answers, not two independent institutions. Proposed action does not show implementation capacity; this threshold is descriptive, not statistical.

title: Discipline + Architecting

quotations.quote: time within our studies and work commitments
give teachers/researchers time in their schedule

description: 8 answers combine Discipline as their dominant future orientation with Architecting as their primary action position.
interpretation: These answers locate change in coordinated provision: workload, staffing, schedules or curriculum rules. Designing participation conditions matters more here than predicting a radically new university.

exceptions.rationale: Dator secondary: Continued Growth. Proposes arranging workload time for courses and meetings. This is proposed local coordination, not evidence that it has been secured.
Dator secondary: Continued Growth. Proposes supporting structures and workload allocation. Institutional authority to implement them is not demonstrated.
Dator secondary: Continued Growth. Specifies coordinator and partner-institution actions for registration, integration and credit recognition. Detailed design is not proof of implementation.
Dator secondary: Continued Growth. Proposes an annual schedule and a dedicated employee role at unit scale. It does not establish that either is funded.

caveat: Recurring means at least two answers, not two independent institutions. Proposed action does not show implementation capacity; this threshold is descriptive, not statistical.
